Initial release of AI-powered pet excitement monitoring and calming guidance

- Real-time camera analysis detects pet over-excitement behaviors (jumping, spinning, running, jumping-on-people) and scores excitement levels.
- Automatically triggers calming actions (voice cues, prompt tones, pheromone diffuser, dim lights) when excitement exceeds safety thresholds.
- Provides structured excitement reports, behavior breakdowns, and intervention suggestions.
- Enforces a strict open-id (user identifier) retrieval and validation workflow before analysis or report queries.
- Includes features for querying and formatting historical analysis reports.
- Designed for use in active pet households, boarding, daycare, and training environments.
